verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence on data controls is that individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time. That covers part of the privacy posture but is not a documented opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking. A community report notes that the technical preview required agreeing to additional telemetry terms, which suggests telemetry was not optional at least during preview. Missing for 10: a documented telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting, IDE/CLI-level telemetry controls, coverage for non-individual (business/enterprise) plans, and independent corroboration that opting out works.
